Resistance distances on a grid of conductance parameters

Source: R/radish_grid.R
terradish_distance.Rd

Calculates resistance distances associated with a parameterized conductance surface across a grid of parameter values.

Usage

terradish_distance(
  theta,
  formula,
  data,
  conductance_model = loglinear_conductance,
  conductance = TRUE,
  covariance = FALSE,
  cores = 1L
)

Arguments

theta

A matrix of dimension (grid size) x (number of parameters)

formula

A formula whose right-hand side names the covariates used to create data. A left-hand side, if supplied, is not used, so a one-sided formula such as ~ forestcover + altitude is sufficient.

data

An object of class terradish_graph (see conductance_surface)

conductance_model

A function of class terradish_conductance_model_factory (see terradish_conductance_model_factory)

conductance

Retained for backward compatibility. Only conductance = TRUE is currently implemented.

covariance

If TRUE, instead of a matrix of resistance distances, return the associated submatrix of the generalized inverse of graph Laplacian

cores

Number of worker processes to use. 1 evaluates the grid serially.

Value

A list of class c("terradish_grid", "radish_grid"):

theta

Data frame of the evaluated conductance coefficients, one row per grid point.

distance

When covariance = FALSE, a focal-site by focal-site by grid-point array of resistance distances. Larger values mean greater graph resistance between two sites. Their units depend on the conductance scale, so compare them within a grid rather than as map distances.

covariance

When covariance = TRUE, the corresponding array of graph covariance (the generalized inverse of the graph Laplacian), returned in place of distance.

See also

terradish_grid, terradish

Other model fitting: conductance(), terradish(), terradish_algorithm(), terradish_grid(), terradish_methods

Examples

library(terra)

data(melip)
covariates <- c(terra::unwrap(melip.altitude),
                terra::unwrap(melip.forestcover))
coords <- terra::unwrap(melip.coords)[1:10]
names(covariates) <- c("altitude", "forestcover")
# Coarsened so the example runs quickly; name layers, then scale.
covariates <- scale_covariates(terra::aggregate(covariates, fact = 5,
                                                na.rm = TRUE))
# Keep one site per raster cell.
keep <- !duplicated(terra::cellFromXY(covariates, terra::crds(coords)))
surface <- conductance_surface(covariates, coords[keep])

theta <- as.matrix(expand.grid(forestcover = seq(-0.5, 0.5, length.out = 3),
                               altitude = seq(-0.5, 0.5, length.out = 3)))

distances <- terradish_distance(theta, ~ forestcover + altitude, surface)

# Resistance distances under uniform conductance (all coefficients zero)
ibd <- which(theta[, 1] == 0 & theta[, 2] == 0)
round(distances$distance[, , ibd], 4)
